title: Pakistan
content: Pakistan is a country located in South Asia. It shares borders with India, Afghanistan, Iran, and China. The Arabian Sea lies to the south.

title: Capital
content: The capital city of Pakistan is Islamabad. Islamabad is known for the Faisal Mosque, Margalla Hills, and its planned city layout.

title: Largest City
content: Karachi is the largest city of Pakistan and an important center for business, trade, industry, and finance.

title: National Language
content: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan. English is also widely used in government, education, business, and law.

title: Provinces
content: Pakistan has four provinces: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan. It also has other administrative territories.

title: Punjab
content: Punjab is one of the provinces of Pakistan. Lahore is the capital of Punjab and is famous for its history, culture, food, and architecture.

title: Sindh
content: Sindh is a province in southeastern Pakistan. Karachi is the capital of Sindh and is the country's largest city.

title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
content: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is a province in northwestern Pakistan. Peshawar is its capital.

title: Balochistan
content: Balochistan is the largest province of Pakistan by area. Quetta is its capital.

title: Independence
content: Pakistan became independent on 14 August 1947. The country was created as a separate homeland for Muslims of British India.

title: Founder
content: Muhammad Ali Jinnah is widely regarded as the founder of Pakistan and is known as Quaid-e-Azam.

title: National Poet
content: Allama Muhammad Iqbal is regarded as the national poet of Pakistan. He played an important intellectual role in the idea of a separate homeland for Muslims.

title: Currency
content: The official currency of Pakistan is the Pakistani Rupee, commonly abbreviated as PKR.

title: National Animal
content: The markhor is the national animal of Pakistan.

title: National Bird
content: The chukar partridge is the national bird of Pakistan.

title: National Flower
content: The jasmine is the national flower of Pakistan.

title: National Sport
content: Field hockey is traditionally recognized as the national sport of Pakistan.

title: Mountains
content: K2 is located in the Karakoram range in Pakistan and is the second-highest mountain in the world.

title: Rivers
content: The Indus River is one of the most important rivers in Pakistan. It supports agriculture, water supply, and many communities.

title: Agriculture
content: Agriculture is an important sector of Pakistan's economy. Major crops include wheat, rice, cotton, sugarcane, and maize.

title: Economy
content: Pakistan has a diverse economy that includes agriculture, manufacturing, services, trade, technology, and telecommunications.
